maddeler.e:
ترتادوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَادُوا (tartādū) /tar.taː.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَادَ (irtāda)
# تُرْتَادُوا (turtādū) /tur.taː.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَادَ (irtāda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
